title: Australian Citrus Chicken Lasagna
description: A flavorful twist on the classic lasagna, with Australian chicken and a hint of citrus.
instructions: Cook lasagna noodles according to package instructions.
In a large skillet, heat olive oil over medium heat. Add onion and garlic; cook until softened.
Add chicken to skillet; cook until browned and cooked through.
Stir in citrus zest, citrus juice, and tomato sauce.
In a large bowl, combine cooked noodles, chicken mixture, and shredded gouda cheese.
In a greased 9x13-inch baking dish, create a layer of noodles, followed by a layer of chicken mixture.
Repeat layering until all ingredients are used, ending with a layer of noodles on top.
Bake for 25-30 minutes or until golden brown.
Sprinkle with chopped cilantro before serving.
